purpose: Keep calligraphy research source-native: reference remote works and request only the representation needed for analysis, without pre-downloading or publishing full-resolution originals.

iiifCompatibility.strategy: When a provider exposes IIIF, use info.json plus region/size requests instead of acquiring the full source image.
iiifCompatibility.note: IIIF is an adapter option, not a requirement. Museum viewers and the site's existing transcode layer may expose equivalent region/tile access.

teacherResearchPriority: derive a glyph crop only when a downstream composition actually needs it

tc001Correction.oldMainline: Acquire high-resolution Shenlong whole-scroll representation, register the complete image, then crop individual glyphs.
tc001Correction.newMainline: Keep Shenlong at source; bind 是 and 和 through remote line/phrase access or existing transcode resources, record normalized/contextual observations, and avoid whole-scroll acquisition.
tc001Correction.imageBoundingBox: optional derived field, not a prerequisite for Teacher Memory
tc001Correction.flowEvidence: parent line + phrase relation + relative spatial/brush observations

runtimeBoundary.research: May inspect remote representations on demand and discard temporary payloads after extracting structured observations.
runtimeBoundary.canonicalCorpus: Stores provenance, metadata, context, observations and approved lightweight derivatives only.
runtimeBoundary.publicCafe: Displays only resources admitted by the public collection gate; research-only sources are never exposed automatically.
runtimeBoundary.futureComposition: Requests the minimum needed glyph/region representation through the adapter/transcode layer at render time or preparation time.

nextGate.name: wang-xizhi-context-first-expansion
nextGate.requirement: Stop waiting for whole-scroll image registration. Expand Wang Xizhi evidence for TC001 and Teacher Memory through source-native transcription, line/phrase context and remote visual inspection; promote spatial fields only when the remote resource exposes a stable coordinate space.
